summary: A pass over your own area: read what is owed and in flight, put each piece of work with whoever can do it, put judgements in front of a person, and name what the area cannot do.
verification: Every piece of work you say you handed over has a job id returned by the handoff tool.
Every promise you say you moved was written to and came back changed.
Nothing is reported as done that no tool result in this job shows was done.
